keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «큰 폭풍이 오고 있었다(문제)» 와 «수줍은 소년이 용기 내어 목소리를 내고 마을을 구했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a big storm was coming) and the solution (the shy boy found his voice and saved his village). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Taeo, a gray whale, the villagers
A big storm was coming, and the boats were far out at sea.
Taeo shouted to call the boats back, and they came home safely.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why did all the boats come home safely?
opts: The villagers trusted Taeo and radioed every boat.
The whale pushed the boats to the shore.
The storm stopped before it came.
evs: The villagers trusted him and radioed every boat.
One night, a deep song answered. It was a huge gray whale!
That night, Taeo sang a thank-you song to the whale.
He was very shy and rarely talked to people.
why: 마을 사람들이 태오를 믿고 모든 배에 무전을 보내서 배들이 폭풍 전에 돌아왔어요. 고래가 배를 밀었다는 말은 없어요.
The villagers trusted Taeo and radioed every boat, so the boats came home before the storm hit. Nothing says the whale pushed the boats.

qs.q: The story says, "A shy boy found his voice." What does "found his voice" mean here?
qs.qko: "A shy boy found his voice."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "found his voice"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: became brave enough to speak up
found a lost toy on the beach
evs: Taeo was shy, but he ran to the harbor and shouted, "Call the boats back!"
But every evening, he sang to the sea from the rocks.
Soon, they "talked" in songs every night.
All the boats came home just before the storm hit.
why: 수줍던 태오가 항구로 달려가 사람들에게 «배들을 돌아오게 하세요!» 하고 외쳤어요. «found his voice»는 용기를 내어 말하게 되었다는 뜻이에요.
Shy Taeo ran to the harbor and shouted to the people, «Call the boats back!» «Found his voice» means he became brave enough to speak up.

qs.q: How did Taeo know a storm was coming?
qs.qko: 태오는 폭풍이 오는 것을 어떻게 알았나요?
opts: The whale's song sounded scared, so he looked at the sky.
A fisherman told him on the radio.
His teacher told him at school.
evs: One evening, the whale's song was fast and scared.
The fishing boats were still far out at sea.
Taeo looked at the sky. A big storm was coming!
The villagers trusted him and radioed every boat.
why: 고래의 노래가 빠르고 겁에 질려 있어서, 태오는 하늘을 보고 큰 폭풍이 오는 것을 알았어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The whale's song was fast and scared, so Taeo looked at the sky and saw a big storm coming. Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: Taeo teaches the village kids to sing to the whale.
태오가 마을 아이들에게 고래에게 노래하는 법을 가르쳐 줘요.
The whale brings its baby to meet Taeo.
고래가 아기 고래를 데리고 태오를 만나러 와요.

write.src: “I want to <u>sing to a whale</u> because <u>whales answer with songs</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «I want to» 뒤에는 동사(sing, visit, learn)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «I want to», write a verb (sing, visit, learn). After «because», write who + what.

img.cover: On dark rocks by the sea at sunset, a nine-year-old Korean boy with neat short black hair, a navy blue raincoat, rolled-up gray pants and yellow rubber boots sings with his hands cupped around his mouth, while a huge gray whale with white spots on its back and kind dark eyes rises out of the waves nearby and sprays a tall fountain of water into the orange sky.

scenes.2: At dusk, a nine-year-old Korean boy with neat short black hair, a navy blue raincoat, rolled-up gray pants and yellow rubber boots stands on the rocks and stares at huge dark storm clouds rolling over the sea, while a huge gray whale with white spots on its back and kind dark eyes swims in fast circles nearby and small fishing boats look like tiny dots far away.
scenes.3: At the busy harbor under a dark, windy sky, a nine-year-old Korean boy with neat short black hair, a navy blue raincoat, rolled-up gray pants and yellow rubber boots shouts with all his might, and villagers in raincoats hurry to a radio in a small wooden hut as the fishing boats sail back home.

alt.2: A boy sees storm clouds as the whale swims fast.
alt.3: A boy shouts at the harbor to call the boats back.
alt.cover: A boy sings on the rocks as a gray whale rises from the sea.
